summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments on Phase 29 (Infrastructure Hardening), then advance the milestone by running the GSD manager to execute Phase 30, plan Phases 31/32, discuss Phase 32, and simplify the Phase 30 code.
summary.outcome: PR #383 review comments resolved and merged; Phase 30 executed (Grafana Faro observability), Phase 31 planned (structural decomposition), Phase 32 discussed and planned (FUSE async FilePointer), Phase 33 roadmapped (Windows WinFsp); Phase 30 code simplified and committed. Milestone at 82% (14/18 phases).

repo: Phase 30 (Web App Observability) integrates Grafana Faro SDK with a beforeSend privacy gate that scrubs privateKey, folderKey, fileKey, tokens, emails, and hex-encoded secrets from all telemetry before transmission.
The FUSE layer uses a channel-based async pattern for content prefetch (PendingContent/content_tx/content_rx/prefetching HashSet) — Phase 32 mirrors this exact pattern for FilePointer resolution.

drain_refresh_completions() in crates/fuse/src/lib.rs calls block_with_timeout() synchronously on the FUSE thread for each unresolved FilePointer, causing Finder 'connection lost' errors with many files — root cause of Phase 32.
The logger transport in faro.ts uses a mutable array injection pattern (registerFaroTransport pushes to caller's transports array) by design for Phase 28 integration — not a bug.
Phase 28 (logger module) has not been executed yet; registerFaroTransport is exported and ready but the main.tsx wiring is deferred until the logger ships.
GitHub env vars VITE_FARO_URL, GRAFANA_FARO_API_KEY, and GRAFANA_STACK_ID need to be configured in the staging environment before Faro activates.
unenrollIpns() previously returned void — changed to return affected count (number) so unenrollBatch() can sum actual deletions instead of overcounting.
scripts/check-api-client.sh uses git diff --quiet to detect unstaged generated file changes — intentional design; removing it would cause false positives on every DTO/controller change.

code.finding: unenrollIpns() was void, changed to return affected row count so unenrollBatch() sums actual deletions rather than incrementing totalUnenrolled for every call regardless of whether rows were deleted.

Faro initialization file — contains scrubValue/scrubObject with depth limit (max 3) and HEX_KEY_PATTERN regex. Added value.length >= 64 early exit before regex for hot-path perf. beforeSend now skips object spread when nothing changed. toStringContext helper extracted to deduplicate error vs warn context transformation.
maxDataPoints was set to 100, inconsistent with db-fallback-rate.json which uses 43200. Fixed to 43200 for consistency.

Test was using private field access (ctx._axiosInstance or similar) and toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0) loose assertion. Replaced with createAxiosInstance() from @cipherbox/api-client and tightened assertion to toBe(0).
drain_refresh_completions() calls block_with_timeout per FilePointer on FUSE thread — root cause of Finder disconnects. Phase 32 refactors this to spawn async tokio tasks.

workflow: GSD manager can parallelize background agents (plan/execute) while running discuss inline — Phase 30 executed + Phase 31 planned while Phase 32 was being discussed interactively.

When a PR branch is merged to main, the worktree for that branch becomes stale and must be removed; ROADMAP.md merge conflicts arise when the squash-merged phase completion status conflicts with local edits.
The /simplify skill launches 3 parallel review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) and aggregates findings — fixes should wait for all agents before committing to avoid missing issues.
Cherry-picking phase context commits across branches is needed when context was captured on a separate branch (e.g., docs branch for Phase 33) and needs to land on the working branch.
CodeRabbit flags git diff --quiet patterns as potentially missing 'never run' scenarios — valid to mark not-applicable with explanation that the alternative causes false positives.
After removing a worktree that held a branch checked out, that branch becomes available again in the main repo.

friction: Switching between worktrees caused branch checkout confusion — editor ended up on Phase 32 branch after Phase 31 worktree cleanup, requiring manual branch switch back to Phase 30.
Phase 31 planning worktree had the phase-31-structural-decomposition branch locked, preventing checkout in main repo until worktree was removed.
Phase 30 simplify edits were made in the main repo while the diff was against the phase-30-web-app-observability branch — required careful verification that edits were on the right branch.
Jest test runner required running from within the specific package directory (apps/api) rather than workspace root — multiple failed attempts before finding correct invocation.
ROADMAP.md merge conflicts on every phase completion as feature branches diverge from main after squash merges.
Phase 32 context was committed on a separate docs branch and required cherry-picking to land on the working branch.
